title: 第8章 回到家乡
content_zh:
第8章回到家乡
数日之后，江南省集训队回去了，许景明也离开了星空格斗馆，准备返回家乡。
下午，滨海市高铁北站。
“一个人在滨海市，照顾好自己。”许景明和黎渺渺拥抱分别，黎渺渺戴着口罩，身边跟着一名女助理。虽然许景明曾经两次杀入世界武道大赛，一次十六强，一次八强，但毕竟公开露脸次数很少，走在大街上，也很少有人能认出他。但黎渺渺不同，她人气很高，即便很佛系的每月仅直播一次，可依旧是有千万粉丝的，不戴口罩，怕是迅速被认出来。
“我这边估计还有两三天，就能全部安排好，到时候就能回去了。孔姐已经提前去明月市，她们的房子都租好了。”黎渺渺说道，孔姐是黎渺渺的两个助理之一。
“小曾，这几天可一定要照顾好你们老板。”许景明对一旁瘦小女助理‘小曾’说道。
“遵命。”小曾立即挺起胸脯应道。
许景明笑着点头，又和女友拥抱了下。
“到家后给我发个消息。”黎渺渺嘱托道。
“好，我出发了。”
许景明转身，背着背包，通过了关卡，去乘坐高铁了。
黎渺渺带着女助理，目送许景明的背影消失在通道中，方才离去。
高铁上，许景明坐在位置上，面前悬浮三尺大的光幕。
光幕只有许景明的角度才能看清，其他角度光亮度都不够，且会变形。
“各位亲朋好友兄弟姐妹们，从今往后，我就定居明月市了！欢迎大家来明月市旅游，我一定全程招待！”许景明在社交圈发了一条讯息，很快就有一条条回复。
“师弟，一路顺风！”这一条留言是星空格斗馆的老板方星龙师兄。
“老许，离开滨海了？”这是当初国家队队友，好兄弟“衡方”。
“师兄，你终于回明月市了，兄弟们早就望眼欲穿了！”这是明月市八极门的师弟“朱佟”。
“回来了，可早点来见我。”这是明月市戳脚门门主“戴通达”，也是许景明少年时的两个师父之一！少年时，许景明的启蒙师父就是自己老爹，而后在老爹引领下，又拜戴通达为师。
“听说明月市是个非常美丽的城市，有机会一定去旅游。”这是国外的世界级武道高手“猎手”米克奇，米克奇曾在夏国学习，精通汉语。

“大高手要回家乡啦，一定要请客吃饭，很多老同学想见见你呢。”是高中同学吴薇。
随着时间，一条条留言接连出现。
有老同学，有亲戚，有在省队、国家队的队友，也有世界武道圈的一些不打不相识的高手朋友们，还有些武道圈经纪人、教练、自己教过的徒弟们。
许景明看着这些留言，也露出笑容，也一一回应着好友们。
京城，中式别墅内。
吃着当天第三顿食物的柳海，也在看着光幕上的社交圈，他每年闭关时，一般吃饭的时候会看看社交圈，了解外界讯息。
“景明离开滨海，回明月市了？”柳海了然，“就是被虎鲨集团那个程子豪逼的。”
“国家重点栽培名单。”
柳海轻轻点了下屏幕，看着名单上的人选，摇头无奈，“找了好几位老友，嘴巴都说破了，景明还是被刷掉了。”
“名单上一共二十人，武道大师十二位，其他格斗流派五位。唯有三个名额可以竞争……最终这三个名额，是两名职业武道选手和一名职业散打选手获得。”
“职业散打选手，是大满贯选手。”
“两名职业武道选手，一个是获得过世界武道大赛的第四！另一个是三次进入过世界八强，成绩都比景明强些。”
这次名单太过特殊，柳海也仅有推荐权，他已经尽力了。
窗外风景呼呼而过。
许景明抬头看向窗外，仅仅在社交圈聊了一会儿，已然进入明月市地界了。
从滨海市到明月市，高铁只需要三十五分钟。
“回家乡了。”许景明心情很好，一眼看去，高铁窗外的河道旁，便是无数的垂柳。江南水乡的景色，让人心旷神怡。
虽然论经济，明月市没法和夏国的经济中心城市‘滨海市’相比，但论宜居，明月市却强太多了。整个城市，仿佛是建造在公园中的城市，城市节奏缓慢，全国都有许多老人搬到这里养老。
“明月市，我回来了。”出高铁站，乘无人驾驶智能汽车，许景明直奔父母的住处，那是一座颇有些历史的别墅区，自己十八岁之前，几乎都是住在这里。
别墅小区内。

许景明走在巷道内，地面的石砖都有了岁月的痕迹，有些还是旧石砖，有些应该是损坏了，被物业换了新的石砖，一处墙壁上模糊的涂鸦痕迹，映入许景明眼帘，不由伸手摸了摸。
这涂鸦，是自己五岁时，在邻居家李大妞家墙上画的，这么多过去了，依旧还残留着模糊痕迹。
走在这条巷道上，就想到小时候自己背着书包上学，老爸接送自己上学的场景。那时候，机器人还没那么智能，是老妈负责做饭，老爸负责接送。
“一转眼，二十年过去了。”许景明走到了熟悉的院门前，轻轻一推，门没锁，提前开了。
许景明走到前院内，前院是三十多平米的小院，许景明小时候很长时间都在这练武。
“爸，妈。”许景明喊道。
“景明回来啦！”
“是景明回来了！”
屋内传来声音，许景明推开客厅的门，便看到父母都已经起身，许母穿着睡衣拖鞋，许父穿着短袖裤衩。毕竟大夏天，在家也很随意。
“景明。”许母看到儿子，开心地抱了下，“想死你老娘了，渺渺呢？就你一个人回来？”
“渺渺过两天回来。”许景明笑着道。
许父走出来，看了看许景明，问道：“你的兵器呢？”
“都快递了，因为东西很多，都是大件重物，所以得明天才能到，都会送到新房那边。”许景明说道。
许父这才点点头。
许父，名叫许洪，身高和许景明相当，体型要魁梧壮得多，毕竟是在明月市开创了八极门的猛人，主修八极，每天都要练桩功，八极门的桩功，像用手臂、胸、肩、背、肘等各处去撞树桩，这也算桩功。还有主练手臂的单臂倒立桩，单臂倒立很难，简化点可用‘双手倒立’，再简化就是‘俯卧撑桩功’……也有锻炼双腿的海底捞月功……
八极门的种种功夫，就是让自己全身每一处都有大力，凶猛如熊虎。
许父，就是虎背熊腰，站在那都有一股霸道气息。
“爸，你要减肥了。”许景明说道，“你现在过两百斤了吧。”
“两百一十斤了。”许父摇头道，“没办法，老了，腰伤经常发，平常练功也得悠着点。每天也就练功两小时，这不，体重就涨上来了。过去我都一直保持在一百九十斤的。”
“练功时间少了，就让你少吃点，还是吃吃吃，能不胖么？”许母的身材却足以让很多年轻女孩羡慕，只是脸上皱纹、头上的些许白发，暴露了许母的年龄。

许母是一位画家，年轻时和许父一同行走全球各地，后来一起定居明月市。
“习惯了吃，控制不住啊。”许父笑道。
“你啊，就是年轻时太好战，去全球各地拜访那些格斗流派，每到一处还经常要切磋。”许母摇头，“打得一身伤，年轻时扛得住，老了就感受到了吧，隔三差五这里疼那里疼。景明，你要引以为戒，以后要以养生为主，少实战。”
“是啊，武道兵器格斗，是很危险。”许父也点头，儿子二十岁时在世界武道大赛擂台上被对手断腿，他们夫妻俩当时在场下看到都慌了。
“放心吧爸妈，我都回明月市定居了，找谁实战？”许景明笑道。
“景明回来啦？”楼上传来声音。
“爷爷？”许景明开心万分。
“你爷爷知道你今天要回来，所以一大早就过来了，下午困了，在上面睡了会儿午觉。”许母说道，“估计是听到我们聊天声音了。”
许景明放下背包，走到别墅的中庭，看到走下来的白发老头，步法还算稳健。
“爷爷。”许景明连走到楼梯旁。
“回来好啊，明月市不比滨海市漂亮舒服么？”白发老头笑得眯起了眼，看到大孙子，他当然开心地很。
“这次回来就不走了，我也好多陪陪爷爷。”许景明也很心疼爷爷。
爷爷，名叫许桂顺，从农村家庭走出来的，年轻时当了职业电竞选手，游戏昵称“无名大师”。
那时候，还是手机游戏！爷爷曾经还拿过一次Fmvp，职业生涯收入也挺高，后来退役后当游戏主播，多年下来也攒下不少钱，许家才算就此攒下了底子。
只是爷爷已经八十八岁了，身体也越来越差了。
“来，吃水果啦。”老爸和老妈，端着两个大果盘，葡萄、香蕉、西瓜，都准备好了。
“吃水果。”许老爷子心情也极好，坐了下来便拿起来一片西瓜递给许景明，“尝尝家乡的西瓜，这些都是本地的瓜。”
“爷爷，我自己来。”许景明也坐下拿起西瓜。
还记得，小时候，爷爷也经常带自己玩，那时候母亲还很年轻，父亲也处于正壮年时，经常带着一群徒弟练武功。
如今，爷爷老了，满是皱纹，脸上都是老人斑。

母亲也有好些白发了，皱纹难掩。父亲虽然魁梧壮硕，但毕竟六十了，也有了暮气。
“生老病死，谁都无法阻挡。”许景明想着，“我长大了，爸妈却老了，爷爷更是过一年少一年。”
回到家，感觉到家庭的温暖，可许景明更感觉到时间的无情。
“这些水果，是你爸上午刚去买的，都是最新鲜的。”许母说道。
“是很好吃。”许景明吃着，笑得开心。

Chapter 8 Returning to Hometown
A few days later, the Jiangnan Province training team returned, and Xu Jingming also left the Star Fighting Gym, preparing to return to his hometown.
In the afternoon, Binhai North High-speed Railway Station.
"You are alone in Binhai City, take care of yourself." Xu Jingming and Li Miaomiao hugged each other and said goodbye. Li Miaomiao was wearing a mask and was accompanied by a female assistant. Although Xu Jingming has reached the World Martial Arts Competition twice, once in the top sixteen and once in the top eight, he has rarely appeared in public, and few people can recognize him when walking on the street. But Li Miaomiao is different. She is very popular. Even though she is very Buddhist and only broadcasts live once a month, she still has tens of millions of fans. Without wearing a mask, she is afraid of being recognized quickly.
"I estimate that I can make all the arrangements in two or three days, and I can go back then. Sister Kong has already gone to Mingyue City in advance, and their houses have been rented." Li Miaomiao said, Sister Kong is one of Li Miaomiao's two assistants.
"Xiao Zeng, you must take good care of your boss these days." Xu Jingming said to the thin female assistant 'Xiao Zeng' beside him.
"Yes." Xiao Zeng immediately puffed up his chest and responded.
Xu Jingming smiled and nodded, and hugged his girlfriend again.
"Send me a message when you get home." Li Miaomiao asked.
"Okay, I'm going."
Xu Jingming turned around, carried his backpack, passed the checkpoint, and went to take the high-speed rail.
Li Miaomiao and her female assistant watched Xu Jingming's back disappear into the passage before leaving.
On the high-speed train, Xu Jingming was sitting with a three-foot light screen suspended in front of him.
The light curtain can only be seen clearly from Xu Jingming's angle. At other angles, the light is not bright enough and will deform.
"Dear relatives, friends, brothers and sisters, from now on, I will settle in Mingyue City! Welcome everyone to travel to Mingyue City, and I will entertain you all the way!" Xu Jingming sent a message in the social circle, and soon there were replies one after another.
"Junior brother, have a nice journey!" This message came from Senior Brother Fang Xinglong, the owner of the Star Fighting Gym.
"Old Xu, have you left Binhai?" This was "Heng Fang", a former teammate of the national team and a good brother.
"Senior brother, you have finally returned to Mingyue City. Brothers have been waiting to see you for a long time!" This is "Zhu Tong", the junior brother of the Baji Sect in Mingyue City.
"You're back, please come and see me early." This is "Dai Tongda", the master of Mingyue City's Stab Foot Sect, and one of Xu Jingming's two masters when he was a boy! When he was young, Xu Jingming's enlightenment master was his father, and then under the guidance of his father, he became his teacher Dai Tongda.
"I heard that Mingyue City is a very beautiful city. I will definitely visit it if I have the opportunity." This is the foreign world-class martial arts master "Hunter" Mikchi. Mikchi studied in Xia Kingdom and is proficient in Chinese.
"The great master is going back to his hometown. You must treat him to dinner. Many old classmates want to meet you." It was Wu Wei, a high school classmate.
As time passed, messages appeared one after another.
There are old classmates, relatives, teammates in the provincial team and the national team, as well as some master friends in the world martial arts circle who have never met each other before, as well as some martial arts circle agents, coaches, and apprentices whom I have taught.
Xu Jingming smiled when he looked at these messages and responded to his friends one by one.
Beijing, inside a Chinese-style villa.
Liu Hai, who was eating his third meal of the day, was also looking at the social circle on the light screen. During his annual retreat, he usually looked at the social circle while eating to learn about outside information.
"Jingming left Binhai and returned to Mingyue City?" Liu Hai understood. "He was forced by Cheng Zihao from the Tiger Shark Group."
"National Key Cultivation List."
Liu Hai tapped the screen lightly, looked at the candidates on the list, and shook his head helplessly, "I went to several old friends and talked about it, but Jing Ming was still removed."
"There are a total of twenty people on the list, twelve martial arts masters and five from other fighting styles. Only three places can compete... In the end, these three places were won by two professional martial arts players and one professional Sanda player."
“Professional Sanda players are Grand Slam players. "
"Two professional martial arts players, one is the fourth in the World Martial Arts Competition! The other one has entered the world's top eight three times, and his results are better than Jing Ming's. "
This time the list is too special, Liu Hai only has the right to recommend it, so he has tried his best.
The scenery outside the window whizzes by.
Xu Jingming raised his head and looked out the window. After just chatting in the social circle for a while, he had already entered the boundaries of Mingyue City.
From Binhai City to Mingyue City, the high-speed train only takes thirty-five minutes.
“Going back to my hometown. "Xu Jingming is in a good mood. At a glance, there are countless weeping willows beside the river outside the high-speed train window. The scenery of the Jiangnan water town is refreshing and refreshing.
Although in terms of economy, Mingyue City cannot be compared with Xia Kingdom's economic center city, 'Binhai City', in terms of livability, Mingyue City is much better. The entire city seems to be built in a park. The pace of the city is slow, and many elderly people from all over the country have moved here to retire.
"Mingyue City, I'm back. "After leaving the high-speed rail station and taking a driverless smart car, Xu Jingming went straight to his parents' residence. It was a villa area with quite a history. He almost lived here before he was eighteen years old.
In the villa community.
Xu Jingming was walking in the alleyway, and the stone bricks on the ground all had traces of time. Some were old stone bricks, and some were probably damaged and had been replaced by new ones by the property management. Xu Jingming's eyes caught the vague traces of graffiti on the wall, and he couldn't help but reach out and touch it.
This graffiti was painted on the wall of my neighbor Li Da Niu's house when I was five years old. After all this time, there are still vague traces.
Walking on this alley reminds me of the scene when I was carrying my schoolbag to school when I was a child, and my father picked me up and dropped me off. At that time, robots were not that smart yet, so my mother was responsible for cooking and my father was responsible for picking up and dropping off.
“Twenty years have passed in the blink of an eye. "Xu Jingming walked to the familiar courtyard door and pushed it gently. The door was unlocked and opened in advance.
Xu Jingming walked to the front yard. The front yard was a small courtyard of more than 30 square meters. Xu Jingming practiced martial arts here for a long time when he was a child.
"Dad, Mom. "Xu Jingming shouted.
"Jingming is back! "
"It's Jingming who's back! "
There was a sound from inside the house. Xu Jingming opened the door of the living room and saw that his parents had already gotten up. Xu's mother was wearing pajamas and slippers, and Xu's father was wearing short-sleeved pants. After all, in the summer, it’s very casual at home.
"Jingming. "When Xu's mother saw her son, she hugged her happily and said, "I miss you so much, where is Miaomiao? Are you the only one coming back? "
“Miaomiao will be back in two days. "Xu Jingming said with a smile.
Xu's father came out, looked at Xu Jingming, and asked, "Where are your weapons? "
“It’s all been delivered by express delivery. Because there are a lot of things, all of them are large and heavy items, so they won’t arrive until tomorrow. They will all be delivered to the new house. "Xu Jingming said.
Father Xu nodded.
Xu's father, named Xu Hong, is about the same height as Xu Jingming, but much burlier and stronger. After all, he is the fierce man who founded the Baji Sect in Mingyue City. He majors in Baji and practices pile skills every day. In Baji Sect's pile skills, he uses his arms, chest, shoulders, back, elbows, etc. to hit tree stumps, which is also considered pile skills. There are also single-arm handstand exercises for training the arms. One-arm handstand is difficult. To simplify it, you can use ‘handstand’, and to simplify it further, it is ‘push-up pile exercise’... There is also Haidilaoyue exercise to exercise the legs...
The various skills of Baji Sect are to make every part of your body powerful and ferocious like a bear or tiger.
Xu's father was as strong as a tiger, and he had a domineering air when he stood there.
“Dad, you need to lose weight. Xu Jingming said, "You must be over two hundred pounds now." "
"Two hundred and ten pounds. Father Xu shook his head and said, "There's nothing I can do. I'm old and my back injuries often occur, so I have to take it easy when I practice martial arts." I only practiced Qigong for two hours a day, but my weight increased. In the past, I have always maintained my weight at 190 pounds. "
"Since we have less time to practice, I will ask you to eat less.Eat, eat, eat, can you not get fat? "Xu's mother's figure is enough to make many young girls envious, but the wrinkles on her face and some white hair on her head reveal Xu's mother's age.
Xu's mother is a painter. When she was young, she traveled around the world with Xu's father, and later settled in Mingyue City together.
“I’m used to eating, I can’t control it. "Father Xu smiled.
"You were just too militant when you were young. You traveled around the world to visit those fighting schools, and you often had to spar with each other wherever you went. "Xu's mother shook her head, "I was beaten all over. I could bear it when I was young, but when I get older, I feel it. It hurts here and there every now and then. Jingming, you should take this as a warning. From now on, you should focus on health care and less on actual combat. "
"Yes, fighting with martial arts weapons is very dangerous. "Xu's father also nodded. When his son was twenty years old, his leg was broken by his opponent in the World Martial Arts Competition. The couple were panicked when they saw it in the audience.
"Don't worry, parents, I have returned to Mingyue City to settle down, who can I find to fight with? "Xu Jingming smiled.
"Jingming is back? "A voice came from upstairs.
"Grandpa? "Xu Jingming was extremely happy.
"Your grandpa knew you were coming back today, so he came here early in the morning. He felt sleepy in the afternoon and took a nap up there. "Xu's mother said, "I guess she heard the sound of our chat. "
Xu Jingming put down his backpack and walked to the atrium of the villa. He saw the white-haired old man walking down, his gait was quite steady.
"Grandpa. "Xu Jingming walked to the stairs.
"It's good to come back. Isn't Mingyue City more beautiful and comfortable than Binhai City? "The white-haired old man smiled and narrowed his eyes. Of course he was very happy when he saw his eldest grandson.
“I won’t leave when I come back this time, and I will spend more time with grandpa. "Xu Jingming also felt sorry for his grandfather.
My grandfather’s name is Xu Guishun. He comes from a rural family. When he was young, he became a professional e-sports player. He was nicknamed "Unknown Master" in the game.
Back then, it was still a mobile game! Grandpa once won Fmvp once, and his career income was quite high. Later, after retiring, he became a game anchor. He also saved a lot of money over the years, and the Xu family finally established the foundation.
But grandpa is already eighty-eight years old, and his health is getting worse.
"Here, let's eat some fruit. "Dad and mom are carrying two big fruit plates, with grapes, bananas, and watermelons all ready.
"Eat fruit. Mr. Xu was in a very good mood. After sitting down, he picked up a piece of watermelon and handed it to Xu Jingming, "Try the watermelon from my hometown. These are all local melons." "
"Grandpa, I'll do it myself. "Xu Jingming also sat down and picked up the watermelon.
I still remember that when I was a child, my grandfather often took me to play. At that time, my mother was still very young and my father was still in his prime. He often led a group of apprentices to practice martial arts.
Nowadays, grandpa is old, full of wrinkles and age spots on his face.
My mother also has a lot of gray hair, and her wrinkles are hard to hide. Although my father was tall and strong, he was already sixty years old and had some signs of aging.
